result.description:
Dear {{ticket.agent.fullname}},

Thanks for contacting the Maroon support team!

We've received your request, and we're diligently working on it and will update you within 24 hours (excluding weekends/holidays).

To check the status of the ticket or add additional comments, use the link below. You can also update this ticket by responding directly to this email.

{{ticket.link}}

Thanks for your patience!

Thanks,
The {{ticket.brand.name}} Team

Hi there! How can we help you today?

09:23 AM BoldDesk Bot  
We're ready to help. Please share your query.

09:25 AM James (Customer)  
Hi, I'm having trouble integrating the Blazor component with my existing project.

09:26 AM Herin (Support Agent)  
Hi James! I'd be happy to assist you. Could you please share which version of Blazor you're using and what kind of issue you're facing during integration?

09:28 AM James (Customer)  
I'm using .NET 7 with Blazor Server. The component doesn't render properly inside a modal.

09:30 AM Herin (Support Agent)  
Thanks for the details. This might be related to lifecycle events or rendering scope. Could you try wrapping the component inside a `RenderFragment` and ensure the modal is initialized after the component loads?

09:32 AM James (Customer)  
Got it. Let me try that and get back to you.

09:45 AM James (Customer)  
That worked! Thanks a lot for the quick help.

09:46 AM Herin (Support Agent)  
You're welcome, James! Feel free to reach out if you need anything else. Have a great day!";
